MATHIEU FUNCTIONS (p.742)
20.9.14  \tau_{r+1}\sim2^{r-1/2}\Big/\Big[2\sqrt q-\tfrac14 w-\dfrac{(2w^2+3)}{64\sqrt q}-\dfrac{(7w^3+47w)}{1024q}-\ldots\Big]
See 20.9.23-20.9.24 for expressions relating to ce_r(0,q) and se'_r(0,q). When |\cos x|>\sqrt{4r+2}/q^{1/4}, 20.9.11-20.9.12 are useful. The approximations become poorer as r increases.
Expansions in Terms of Parabolic Cylinder Functions
(Good for angles close to \tfrac12\pi, for large values of q, especially when |\cos x|<2^{1/2}/q^{1/4}.) Due to Sips [20.44-20.46].
20.9.15  ce_r(x,q)\sim C_r[Z_0(\alpha)+Z_1(\alpha)]
20.9.16  se_{r+1}(x,q)\sim S_r[Z_0(\alpha)-Z_1(\alpha)]\sin x,\qquad \alpha=2q^{1/2}\cos x.
Let D_k=D_k(\alpha)=(-1)^k e^{\frac12\alpha^2}\dfrac{d^k}{d\alpha^k}e^{-\frac12\alpha^2}.
20.9.17  Z_0(\alpha)\sim D_r+\dfrac{1}{4q^{1/2}}\Big[-\dfrac{D_{r+4}}{16}+\dfrac32\binom{r}{4}D_{r-4}\Big]+\dfrac{1}{16q}\Big[\dfrac{D_{r+8}}{512}-\dfrac{(r+2)D_{r+4}}{16}+\dfrac32(r-1)\binom{r}{4}D_{r-4}+\dfrac{315}{4}\binom{r}{8}D_{r-8}\Big]+\ldots
20.9.18  Z_1(\alpha)\sim\dfrac{1}{4q^{1/2}}\Big[-\dfrac14D_{r+2}-\dfrac{r(r-1)}{4}D_{r-2}\Big]+\dfrac{1}{16q}\Big[\dfrac{D_{r+6}}{64}+\dfrac{(r^2-25r-36)}{64}D_{r+2}+\dfrac{r(r-1)(-r^2-27r+10)}{64}D_{r-2}-\dfrac{45}{4}\binom{r}{6}D_{r-6}+\ldots\Big]
20.9.19  C_r\sim\Big(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\Big)^{1/4}q^{1/8}/(r!)^{1/2}\Big[1+\dfrac{2r+1}{8q^{1/2}}+\dfrac{r^4+2r^3+263r^2+262r+108}{2048q}+\dfrac{f_1}{16384q^{3/2}}+\ldots\Big]^{-1/2}
f_1=6r^5+15r^4+1280r^3+1905r^2+1778r+572
20.9.20  S_r\sim\Big(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\Big)^{1/4}q^{1/8}/(r!)^{1/2}\Big[1-\dfrac{2r+1}{8q^{1/2}}+\dfrac{r^4+2r^3-121r^2-122r-84}{2048q}+\dfrac{f_2}{16384q^{3/2}}+\ldots\Big]^{-1/2}
f_2=2r^5+5r^4-416r^3-629r^2-1162r-476
It should be noted that 20.9.15 is also valid as an approximation for se_{r+1}(x,q), but 20.9.16 may give slightly better results. See [20.4.]
Explicit Expansions for Orders 0, 1, to Terms in q^{-3/2} (q Large)
20.9.21  For r=0:
Z_0\sim D_0-\dfrac{D_4}{64\sqrt q}+\dfrac1{16q}\Big(-\dfrac{D_4}{8}+\dfrac{D_8}{512}\Big)+\dfrac1{64q^{3/2}}\Big(-\dfrac{99D_4}{256}+\dfrac{3D_8}{256}-\dfrac{D_{12}}{24576}\Big)+\ldots
Z_1\sim\dfrac{-D_2}{16\sqrt q}+\dfrac1{16q}\Big(-\dfrac{9D_2}{16}+\dfrac{D_6}{64}\Big)+\dfrac1{64q^{3/2}}\Big(-\dfrac{61D_2}{32}+\dfrac{25D_6}{256}-\dfrac{5D_{10}}{10240}\Big)+\ldots
20.9.22  For r=1:
Z_0\sim D_1-\dfrac{D_5}{64\sqrt q}+\dfrac1{16q}\Big(-\dfrac{3D_5}{16}+\dfrac{D_9}{512}\Big)+\dfrac1{64q^{3/2}}\Big(-\dfrac{207D_5}{256}+\dfrac{D_9}{64}-\dfrac{D_{13}}{24576}\Big)+\ldots
Z_1\sim\dfrac{-D_3}{16\sqrt q}+\dfrac1{16q}\Big(-\dfrac{15D_3}{16}+\dfrac{D_7}{64}\Big)+\dfrac1{64q^{3/2}}\Big(-\dfrac{153D_3}{32}+\dfrac{35D_7}{256}-\dfrac{D_{11}}{2048}\Big)+\ldots
Formulas Involving ce_r(0,q) and se_r(0,q)
20.9.23  \dfrac{ce_0(0,q)}{ce_0(\frac12\pi,q)}\sim2\sqrt2\,e^{-2\sqrt q}\Big(1+\dfrac1{16\sqrt q}+\dfrac9{256q}+\ldots\Big)
\dfrac{ce_2(0,q)}{ce_2(\frac12\pi,q)}\sim-32q\sqrt2\,e^{-2\sqrt q}\Big(1-\dfrac1{16\sqrt q}+\dfrac{29}{128q}+\ldots\Big)
